plan.hypothesis: With controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0, control tip-speed weights frozen at the incumbent 0.05/0.05 and all task/timing/acceptance/numerics unchanged, lengthening one flexible segment (components/far/length_m 0.11 -> 0.13 or components/near/length_m 0.16 -> 0.17) lowers effective bending stiffness and the residual end-of-horizon oscillation frequency enough to reduce sampled holding_max_speed_m_s without pushing terminal_error_m or holding_max_error_m beyond the frozen limits, yielding a fresh nominal joint pass with a componentwise non-worsening physical profile against the retained incumbent.
plan.rationale: Isolated explicit probes rebuilt on the retained baseline source, with control tip-speed weights frozen at terminal 0.05 and holding 0.05 so each candidate varies exactly one builder path. Motivation from actual feedback: the two most recent changed points were accepted but strictly dominated (F566/F571/F702; F588/F694/F524), and every executed section-scale increase raised sampled holding speed, so the granted section-scale axis is already exhausted at its 0.95 lower bound and the near/far length paths remain untested. Mathematical assumption: for a fixed cross-section, effective bending compliance of a segment grows roughly with L^3 while its mass grows with L, so lengthening the flexible segments should lower the dominant residual oscillation frequency and may lower sampled holding tip speed; this is a local, affine-like stiffness argument only. The shared v7 controller, solver recipe, stopping rules, target, duration 0.35 s, period 0.01 s, physics 0.0005 s, inclusive 0.05 s window, 0.01 m position and 0.02 m/s speed limits are unchanged, so no gradient, monotonicity, braking or perturbed-robustness guarantee follows, and M5 retained prediction evidence has no screening authority. Allocation: at most 2 new backend attempts, 2 distinct changed configurations, nominal seed 17, one closed-loop execution each. Expected information: a first sign and magnitude read on whether segment length can reduce holding speed without worsening position error, or else another dominated pass or holding-speed failure. Exit: stop on material failure or after two changed configurations complete; no inner search and no extra control budget.
weakening_observations: Every previously executed granted structural edit either passed while being worse on all three sampled physical metrics (F566/F571/F702) or failed sampled holding speed (holding_max_speed_m_s 0.054580793692926934 on the near-section 1.05 point); none was componentwise non-worsening.

The incumbent already uses the lower bound of design/near_section_scale and design/far_section_scale (0.95) and of components/far/length_m (0.11), so the observable 'softer' direction on the scale axis is exhausted and the length prediction rests only on stiffness-scaling intuition.
No screened prediction authority, no matched perturbed incumbent reference and no seed-18 repeat exist, so the expected benefit of two further probes is uncertain.
